source_policy.selection: Exactly one unique explicitly labeled model-card PDF pointer on the official landing page; no arbitrary version ranking or report fallback
source_policy.identity: Actual native model/version/Preview identity comes only from the acquired card

stop_condition: One finite cycle: one official page and at most one explicit model-card PDF. Stop with primary-evidence gap on access failure, missing/ambiguous pointer or unsupported identity/framework. No other provider, guessed URI, mirror, inference/API or outreach.
